protocol.scope: Optimistic TRAIN screening only; no held-out/model inference
protocol.fit: Same six TRAIN documents, tokens0:256, own LEGACY_P_PRE path, same legacy high8 mask; per layer/head/low row/group min/max across documents and tokens; no weighting or percentile fitting
protocol.grid: Offset=floor_half(min); scale=ceil_half(max((max-offset)/255,2^-24)); zero-only scale1; exact R2_OFFSET metadata on extrema. Retain same grid on every candidate write
protocol.runtime: FP32 H32, original high FP16, UINT8 low code round((x-offset)/scale) clamp0:255; FP16 metadata stored; R2 input/payload guards; no fallback or FP32 master
protocol.grid_distribution_shift: Outside-grid codes clamp with counts; inputs beyond R2 finite range reject; clipping is judged by preregistered threshold
protocol.rationale: Fixed before candidate measurements. Same exploratory quality/clipping allowances as first candidate, not calibrated to fixed-grid outcomes.
protocol.components: Triggered by initial-grid repeat drift <=50% R2; two diagnostics replace only offset or scale after fresh R2 calculation, without recalculating the other component; not deployable candidates
protocol.gpu_dev: Only if CPU selection passes; extend same fit rule to all18 TRAIN layers then freeze before unchanged model DEV. Otherwise no new model/calibration/task/timing phases.
